item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the winter monsoon, the weather will still be relatively cold and windy over the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the region. A replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The weather will improve with cold mornings over the region in the latter part of this week. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream early next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise.
